audience: finance and revenue teams that check customer balances, invoices and usage in Metronome

useCases.title: Check a customer's commit and credit balances
useCases.text: List the customers, then read the commit and credit balances of one customer. Read the combined net balance across commits and credits.

useCases.title: Review usage per billable metric
useCases.text: List the billable metrics, then read the usage of one or more customers over a period. The usage can be hourly, daily or one total.

useCases.title: Review a customer's invoices
useCases.text: List a customer's invoices, filtered by type, dates or contract. Open one to read its line items, applied credits and totals.

useCases.title: Send usage events for a customer
useCases.text: Send 1 to 100 usage events, each with a unique transaction ID. Each event bills the customer, so send only events you mean to bill.
